items.title: The Fitting ideals of a finite type module represent the loci where it is generated by r sections and where it is locally free of rank r
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the Fitting ideals of a finite type quasi-coherent module with the loci where the module can be generated by at most r sections and where it is locally free of rank r, and adds finite presentation statements for those loci when the module is finitely presented (statement lines 1383-1422). The counted proof is short but does two things: it proves the emptiness of the intersection of the Fitting closed subschemes by a local generator count over affine opens, and it translates the two representable functors of the statement into pullback conditions on the r-th and the (r-1)-st Fitting ideal using base change and the same-chapter criteria (proof lines 1424-1456). It is H2: the work is the correct identification of the functors involved, and the cited inputs are the standard base change and criterion statements.
